notes: Two replicas of one shard using ReplicatedMergeTree with ClickHouse Keeper; DDL runs ON CLUSTER. No transactions, no foreign keys; secondary "indexes" are data-skipping (bloom filter) indexes; UPDATE/DELETE are asynchronous mutations.

ddl:
CREATE TABLE customers ON CLUSTER lab_cluster (
  id Int32,
  name String,
  email String,
  country_code String,
  tier String,
  created_at DateTime64(6),
  attrs Nullable(String)
) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/{shard}/{database}/customers', '{replica}') ORDER BY (id)

CREATE TABLE categories ON CLUSTER lab_cluster (
  id Int32,
  parent_id Nullable(Int32),
  name String,
  depth Int32
) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/{shard}/{database}/categories', '{replica}') ORDER BY (id)

CREATE TABLE products ON CLUSTER lab_cluster (
  id Int32,
  category_id Int32,
  sku String,
  name String,
  description String,
  price Decimal(12,2),
  attrs Nullable(String),
  active Bool
) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/{shard}/{database}/products', '{replica}') ORDER BY (id)

CREATE TABLE orders ON CLUSTER lab_cluster (
  id Int32,
  customer_id Int32,
  status String,
  ordered_at DateTime64(6),
  total_amount Decimal(14,2),
  shipping_country String
) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/{shard}/{database}/orders', '{replica}') ORDER BY (id)

CREATE TABLE order_items ON CLUSTER lab_cluster (
  id Int32,
  order_id Int32,
  product_id Int32,
  qty Int32,
  unit_price Decimal(12,2)
) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/{shard}/{database}/order_items', '{replica}') ORDER BY (id)

CREATE TABLE events ON CLUSTER lab_cluster (
  id Int64,
  customer_id Int32,
  event_type String,
  occurred_at DateTime64(6),
  payload Nullable(String),
  value_num Decimal(12,4)
) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/{shard}/{database}/events', '{replica}') ORDER BY (id)

CREATE TABLE inventory ON CLUSTER lab_cluster (
  product_id Int32,
  warehouse_id Int32,
  qty Int32,
  updated_at DateTime64(6)
) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/{shard}/{database}/inventory', '{replica}') ORDER BY (product_id, warehouse_id)
ALTER TABLE products ADD INDEX ix_products_category_id (category_id) TYPE bloom_filter GRANULARITY 4
ALTER TABLE products MATERIALIZE INDEX ix_products_category_id
ALTER TABLE orders ADD INDEX ix_orders_customer_id (customer_id) TYPE bloom_filter GRANULARITY 4
ALTER TABLE orders MATERIALIZE INDEX ix_orders_customer_id
ALTER TABLE order_items ADD INDEX ix_order_items_order_id (order_id) TYPE bloom_filter GRANULARITY 4
ALTER TABLE order_items MATERIALIZE INDEX ix_order_items_order_id
ALTER TABLE order_items ADD INDEX ix_order_items_product_id (product_id) TYPE bloom_filter GRANULARITY 4
ALTER TABLE order_items MATERIALIZE INDEX ix_order_items_product_id
ALTER TABLE events ADD INDEX ix_events_customer_id (customer_id) TYPE bloom_filter GRANULARITY 4
ALTER TABLE events MATERIALIZE INDEX ix_events_customer_id
